name: Simulate a construction file
description: Run a construction file through the C6 simulator, resolving every named oligo and plasmid across the whole project folder, and report the product of each step with its length. Optionally check whether a sequencing primer anneals inside those products, where, and whether it has more than one site. Answers 'does this plan actually make the thing' and 'will this sequencing primer read it' — neither of which a structural check can see.
phrases: does this PCR give the right product
does the sequencing primer anneal in the PCR product
is this primer inside the product
how big is the PCR product
does the simulated plasmid match the recorded map
check a construction file against the sequences

inputs.name: --project
inputs.description: the project directory to resolve sequences from; defaults to the file's own directory

inputs.name: --primes
inputs.description: an oligo name to locate inside each product

outputs.name: products
outputs.description: each step's product and its length in bp

outputs.name: missing
outputs.description: named inputs with no sequence anywhere in the project

outputs.name: anneal
outputs.description: on an annealing failure, each primer's longest 3'-anchored exact match, so a designed mutation is not mistaken for a defect
